Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest

Class AutomationChecks

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.gametest.AutomationChecks
public final class AutomationChecks extends Object
Loader-neutral automation semantics exercised directly through StackRunItemAccess.

    barAutomationBackfillsWithoutDropping(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    To reproduce in-game: fill a supported Bar column, automate extraction from its base, and verify the top bar backfills the hole without an item entity being dropped.
    static void
    barBackfillKeepsAStoredItemNoLongerAccepted(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    To reproduce in-game: narrow the ingot rule after storing a bar, then automate extraction below it; backfill retains or drops the now-ineligible stored item without deleting it.
    static void
    barInsertionAnswersForThePositionItIsGiven(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    To reproduce in-game: target individual Bar positions with automation; unsupported positions refuse insertion while a grounded empty position accepts exactly one bar.
    static void
    singlesExtractionUsesThePlayerGravityPath(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
    To reproduce in-game: extract a lower Singles cell through item automation; the item above shifts down by the same gravity path used for player extraction.

    singlesInsertionAnswersForTheCellItIsGiven(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)

    singlesWalkFillsFromTheBottom(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
